# Prompt template management for semantic extraction and Jira linkage

Defines and generates versioned prompt templates for semantic extraction of engineering knowledge from source files and for linking Jira stories to compiled features. This enables consistent, cacheable, and evolvable natural-language prompts for an LLM-based knowledge compiler workflow.
